title: Twisted Limits Escape Room
specs: Escape rooms with immersive, themed scenarios and puzzles
Axe throwing with digitally projected games and multiple game types
Laser tag arena with advanced equipment and multiple game modes
Escape rooms ages 14+ unsupervised; ages 10-14 with parent/guardian; under 10 not recommended
Axe throwing ages 18+; ages 12-18 allowed with parent/guardian
Escape rooms designed for 4-6 players per room
Axe throwing lounge has 12 lanes, max 4 per lane recommended
Laser tag recommended 8-16 players, max 20 players
includes: Live game master for Eureka Escape Games
Digitally projected games on end grain boards for axe throwing
Laser combat equipment and multiple game modes for laser tag
gap: Cancellation and refund policy not stated
blurb: Twisted Limits offers multiple escape rooms with themed interactive scenarios where teams solve puzzles to complete objectives. They also have an axe throwing lounge with 12 lanes and digitally projected games, and a laser tag arena with a 3,000 square foot battleground and advanced equipment. All activities require booking appointments and have age restrictions.
extraNote: Hours are appointment-only; location may not be staffed without reservations · Booking requires first/last name, email, phone number; pay on arrival option available · Guests may bring own food and drink; concessions available on-site for laser tag
